description_ru: Забавное, но искреннее мнение в пользу чая.
text:
Some people drink coffee every morning. I do not. I think tea is better than coffee.

First, tea is gentle. Coffee wakes me up too fast, and then my hands shake. Tea gives me a calm start to the day.

Second, there are many kinds of tea: black tea, green tea, fruit tea and mint tea. I try a new one every week. Coffee is always the same for me, bitter and strong.

Third, tea is a time to talk. My grandmother makes tea in a big teapot, and we sit together and share stories.

Try a cup of tea tonight. I think you will agree!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Звуки p, t, k в начале ударного слога произносите с лёгким выдохом, как будто дуете на ладонь.
Спинка языка прижата к мягкому нёбу, воздух идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.

questions.question: What does the writer prefer, tea or coffee?
Why is coffee not good for the writer?
questions.answer: It wakes the writer up too fast and the hands shake.
